title: Step 2 - How to Create a Logistic Regression Classifier Using R's GLM Function

cues.en: Hello and welcome to this art tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So in a previous tutorial we just pre-processed our data set to make it ready for our logistic regression model that we will fit on the training sets.
cues.zh: 上次已完成前處理，準備在訓練集上擬合邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: So that's what we're going to do in this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這就是本節要做的。

cues.en: And let's do it right now.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: So it's going to be very simple.
cues.zh: 非常簡單。

cues.en: We're just going to create our classifier equals and then we're going to use an existing function of
cues.zh: 建立 classifier，接著等號，使用 R 現有的

cues.en: our go the G.L. and function that is going to build this logistic regression classifier.
cues.zh: glm 函數，建立邏輯斯迴歸分類器。

cues.en: So let's type here G L M and then let's press F 1 to see what parameters we have to input.
cues.zh: 輸入 glm，再按 F1 查看需要的參數。

cues.en: OK so the first thing we see is that GM is for generalized linear models and that's because the logistic regression is a linear classifier for those of you who didn't follow the Python tutorial you will see
cues.zh: 首先看到，GLM 是廣義線性模型，因為邏輯斯迴歸是線性分類器。沒看 Python 教學的人，稍後會看到

cues.en: that our logistic regression classifier will linearly separate our two classes of users.
cues.zh: 分類器以線性方式區分兩類使用者。

cues.en: And then let's look at the arguments to see where we have to input.
cues.zh: 看引數，需要填什麼？

cues.en: All right so the first argument is formula.
cues.zh: 第一個是 formula。

cues.en: So that's the same as what we did in the regression section.
cues.zh: 和迴歸部分一樣。

cues.en: Here we're going to write formula equals and then we take the dependent variable which is purchased
cues.zh: 寫 formula=Purchased，也就是應變數，

cues.en: then out plus N and then here a dot to specify that we want to take all the independent variables.
cues.zh: 再按 Alt+N 輸入波浪號，加句點表示取所有自變數。

cues.en: So that way are understands that we want to predict the pre-Chase result based on all the independent
cues.zh: R 就知道，要根據所有自變數預測 Purchased，

cues.en: variables which are the age and the estimated salary.
cues.zh: 自變數是年齡與估計薪資。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now what is the next argument.
cues.zh: 下一個引數是什麼？

cues.en: So let's come here enter and let's add the second argument.
cues.zh: 加逗號、換行，填第二個引數。

cues.en: So the second argument is family and here since we are in logistic regression we are going to add family equals binomial.
cues.zh: 第二個是 family，因為是邏輯斯迴歸，所以設 family=binomial。

cues.en: So at this stage it's not important to understand what binomial means exactly but you just have to remember
cues.zh: 現階段不用精確了解 binomial 的意義，只需記得，

cues.en: that for logistic regression you have to specify the binomial family here and then we just need to input one last argument.
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸必須指定 binomial 家族。最後再加一個引數。

cues.en: It's the data here which is the data on which you want to train your logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 就是 data，要用來訓練模型的資料。

cues.en: So of course that's our training set.
cues.zh: 當然是訓練集。

cues.en: So we're going to add here data equals training set.
cues.zh: 所以填 data=training_set。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 在這裡。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And that's it by only using this deal in function and resizing the formula the family and the fact that we're building the model on the training set that builds our logistic regression classifier.
cues.zh: 只用 glm，指定 formula、family 和 training_set，就建立了分類器。

cues.en: So now let's see like this come on control plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 選取並按 Command 或 Control+Enter 執行。

cues.en: And here we go the classifier is built.
cues.zh: 分類器已建立。

cues.en: OK so that's it for this tutorial we finished logistic regression to the trainset and then the next tutorial we will be predicting the test results using this classifier that we just built.
cues.zh: 這節完成將模型擬合到訓練集；下節用新分類器預測測試集。

cues.en: All right thank you for watching this tutorial.
cues.zh: 感謝觀看。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you in the next one.
cues.zh: 期待下節見。

cues.en: And until then enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
